guides.title: CDR/Damage Nox
guides.notes:
I have 12k+ Worshipers on Nox. This is my guide.

I rush cooldown and am able to use my combo every 5-7 seconds depending on Chronos Pendant Passive. It works for me, and it allows me to not only get kills, but support my teammates with the silence and root.

If you have questions or need help you can find me on Twitter.com/IzanamiGG or on Discord at Izanami#5099
